dara (partnerships): FYI OpenAtlas submitted a bundle claiming 'commercial redistribution allowed'. They attached a contributors CSV and a license summary but nothing crypto-signed. We need to decide what marketplace channels we allow and how to coordinate any joint announcement.

sylvie (legal): Quick flags: (1) "commercial redistribution" needs precise scope — downstream redistribution vs. hosting-as-a-service. (2) Confirm no CC-BY-SA or patent-encumbered datasets. (3) Require provider attestation + signed release (gpg or sigstore).

noah (hw-partner): If this model ships on our partner edge devices (HW partner program), we need an explicit redistribution carveout for hardware-bundled deployments. That typically requires a separate SOW with binary redistribution rights.

tomas (eng): From runtime side, we need quantization artifacts and a compatibility matrix for our inference stack. Also, listing should indicate which compiled builds we can redistribute (e.g., int8 quantized .qat vs float32).

marcus (marketplace): Marketplace options: 1) Hosted-only listing (no redistribution), 2) Marketplace SKU (we host and can provide partner bundles), 3) Redistributable SKU (allows downloads and partner bundling). For OpenAtlas, until legal confirms, mark as Hosted-only and add "redistribution_pending" flag.

dara (partnerships): Good. Also OpenAtlas asked for a co-marketing blog + joint webinar. We can't schedule that until legal confirms redistribution/export. Suggest holding off on announcement sync.

sylvie (legal): Actionables for provider: signed attestation (template to follow), commit hashes with verifiable signatures, contributor CLAs or confirmation, dataset manifests with licenses, and export-origin statement (list of contributor countries).

announce-bot: REMINDER: do not ping press channels until legal_approval == true.

noah (hw-partner): If redistribution is granted, HW bundle checklist: firmware compatibility note, device licensing text, vulnerability disclosure contact, and a limit on re-distribution to authorized resellers.

tomas (eng): We'll add an auto-rollback hook to the packaging pipeline. If legal flags a takedown, packages get quarantined and new installs blocked until review. Example: `package.publish() unless legal_clearance == true`.

marcus (marketplace): For listing metadata, we need: model name, semantic version, tensor format, quantized variants, benchmarks (latency @ batch sizes), attribution text, allowed channels (hosted/dedicated/redistribute), and ops contact. If redistribution is restricted we show a badge: "Redistribution: Restricted".

dara (partnerships): I've asked OpenAtlas for the attestation and signed tags. ETA 72h. I've also asked them to indicate if they want HW partner bundling.

sylvie (legal): I'll draft a short redistribution clause to propose. Rough sketch: "Provider grants Redwood the limited right to host and, upon explicit written approval, to distribute model binaries to authorized resellers and hardware partners. Any further redistribution requires Provider's prior written consent." Will post template on the partnerships board.

noah (hw-partner): If they accept the hardware carveout, we can move forward with a co-branded kit but need to finalize revenue share and a security review.

tomas (eng): Can we gate co-marketing on a successful security review and a signed redistribution addendum? That seems sensible.

marcus (marketplace): Agreed. Market launch checklist for co-marketing: legal_clearance == true, export_check == pass, hw_bundle_rights == agreed (if applicable), and marketing copy approved.

dara (partnerships): Recap/action items: (1) Dara to get signed tags + attestation + HW bundling intent from OpenAtlas (ETA 72h). (2) Sylvie to post redistribution clause + attestation template (ETA 48h). (3) Marcus to prepare listing flags and co-marketing checklist. (4) Tomas to add auto-quarantine & package rollback in packaging pipeline.

announce-bot: NOTE: Tentative listing review penciled for next Tue pending docs.

dara (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll update this thread when provider docs arrive. Please add any blockers here. :handshake:
